declarations.name: OcelleFacts

members.name: density
members.description:
Row spacing: `compact` tightens the gaps for dense screens. Unset gives the default spacing. It does not change
the type: in a `data-ocelle-density="compact"` region the values take the region's scale. Reflected.

members.name: layout
members.description:
`columns` keeps two columns and `stacked` one column at any size. `grid` shows each pair as a cell, label above
value, in four, two or one columns from the sheet's own inline size (four from twice `--ocelle-facts-stack-below`,
two from it, one below it). Unset, or any other value, switches automatically on the sheet's own two-column inline
size; set it for a sheet in a dialog, popover or other shrink-to-fit host, where a short sheet would otherwise
stack. Reflected.

declarations.description:
A label and value sheet: one description list of its `ocelle-fact` children, in two columns, stacked or as a grid of
cells.

cssProperties.name: --ocelle-facts-stack-below
cssProperties.description: With `layout` unset, below this inline size (the sheet's own, as laid out in two columns) each value stacks under its label; with `layout="grid"`, below it the cells take one column and from twice it four (the sheet's own size as laid out in four columns). An absolute length; a percentage, 0 or an invalid value falls back to the default, 24rem from tokens (`calc(var(--ocelle-space-10) * 6)`).

cssProperties.name: --ocelle-facts-value-size
cssProperties.description: The values' font size, `--ocelle-font-size-fact` by default. Set by `@ocelle/styles`' density hook (`--ocelle-font-size-sm` in a compact region).

cssProperties.name: --ocelle-facts-value-line-height
cssProperties.description: The values' line height, `--ocelle-line-height-normal` by default. Set by `@ocelle/styles`' density hook (`--ocelle-line-height-compact` in a compact region).

cssParts.name: list
cssParts.description: The description list grid. Do not set its columns: a `grid-template-columns` rule here overrides every layout.

cssParts.description: Each term (label). Carries the fact's `lang` and `dir`.

cssParts.name: value
cssParts.description: Each definition (value) box.

declarations.name: OcelleProgress

members.name: value
members.description:
The current amount, from 0 to `max`: below 0 counts as 0, above `max` as `max`. Unset, `null`, an empty or
whitespace-only attribute, or a value that is not a finite number makes the bar indeterminate. Not reflected.

members.name: max
members.description: The maximum. Unset, not a finite number, or 0 or less counts as 100. Not reflected.

members.name: valueText
members.description:
Words for the current value, for example "7 of 12", exposed (and shown with `show-label`) while the bar is
determinate, as given. Unset lets the platform announce the value. Not reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name, as text (no rich label). A bar needs a name: set `label`, or a host `aria-label`, which
overrides it. To name a bar after a nearby heading, pass the heading's text. Not reflected.

members.name: showLabel
members.description:
Shows the label as text above the bar (beside it in compact), and the value text while determinate. Unset hides
both; the name and value are exposed either way.

members.name: size
members.description: `compact` is a thin bar with the label beside it. Unset, or any other value, gives the default size. Reflected.

members.name: ground
members.description:
`tinted` draws the track's boundary in the accent-strong colour, for a bar on an inset, accent-low, hover or state
ground. Unset is for the canvas, sheet, pane, panel, inspector and rail grounds. Reflected.
